# Moovma · Elyssa, the first Tunisian dev board

> Moovma is a Tunisian hardware company and community, founded by Bejaoui Hamza. Its first product, Elyssa,
> is "the first Tunisian dev board": an open-source ESP32-S3 development board designed in Tunisia,
> programmed with the Arduino IDE. Website: https://www.moovma.tn · Contact: moovmabh@gmail.com

## Elyssa in short

- Chip: ESP32-S3FN8, 2 cores, 240 MHz, 8 MB flash (no PSRAM)
- Wireless: Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz and Bluetooth LE 5, on-board PCB antenna
- On the board: RGB LED, 6-axis motion sensor (LSM6DS3TR-C), microSD slot, LiPo battery charger (BQ24092), Qwiic connector, native USB-C, BOOT and RESET buttons
- Header: 22 pins (IO0 to IO6 analog + touch, I2C, SPI, UART, 3 PWM outputs, 3.3 V, Vin, Gnd)
- Software: Arduino IDE 2 with the Moovma board package; open source (MIT) on GitHub

## Power (common questions)

- Logic is 3.3 V. Pins are not 5 V tolerant: use a level shifter for 5 V signals.
- Power it from USB-C (5 V), from Vin (5 V, only when USB is unplugged), or from one 3.7 V LiPo cell.
- 12 V (or 9 V) cannot be connected directly: the 3.3 V regulator accepts at most 5.5 V. Use a 12 V to 5 V step-down (buck) module into Vin and Gnd, with USB unplugged.
- Keep each GPIO under about 20 mA.
